name: Lecithins
aliases: E322, lecithins, lecithin, phosphatides, phospholipids, lecitina, lecitinas, lécithine, soy lecithin, egg lecithin, sunflower lecithin, sunflower lecithins, rapeseed lecithin
what_is: A natural mixture of phosphatides obtained by physical procedures from animal or vegetable foodstuffs.
why_botia: It flags it because it is an emulsifier that can be derived from plant sources (like soy) or animal sources (like egg yolk), impacting vegan and allergen preferences.
can_1: Detect the presence of E322 or lecithin on the ingredient list.
can_2: Warn consumers if the label specifies a highly allergenic source such as egg or soy.
cannot_1: Identify the botanical or animal source if the manufacturer only declares 'lecithins' under generic terms where allowed.
cannot_2: Determine whether hydrogen peroxide was used to bleach the lecithin during processing.
